title: 皐月賞の後に・師に捧げる栄冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has won the Satsuki Sho! Showered in praise from the audience and feeling their support, she beams with joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's race has shown Yaeno Muteki just how much she's improved. She's now certain that she's on the right path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there are still more races to go in the Classic Triple Crown tour. Next up is the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I call Yaeno Muteki's family to let them know about her victory. When she hears how incredibly moved her family is, her determination burns even brighter!
